objectives.title: Compile and test complete projects, starting with ACE
acceptance: Capture exact source and immutable locks in native ACE versions
Compile Rust and TypeScript offline in an isolated container
Protect the evaluation suite from candidate edits
Retain source, reports and learning for passing and failing proposals
Expose retained results and project tasks in Observatory

objectives.title: Demonstrate repeatable improvements on complete tasks
acceptance: Start from a reproducibly failing independent test
Record declared agent provenance and the exact proposal
Accept improvement only when target tests pass and existing checks do not regress
Compare multiple tasks and generations with measured duration and resource limits
Keep provider faults distinct from incorrect code

objectives.title: Retrieve relevant, evidence-backed learning
acceptance: Retrieve prior failures and successes within authorized projects
Link every claim to exact source, evaluator and results
Reject stale or incompatible evidence
Demonstrate a measured benefit on fresh tasks

objectives.title: Deliver installable, independently verified developer packages
acceptance: Verify Linux, Windows and both macOS architectures
Publish versioned packages with checksums and install instructions
Exercise installation and examples without developer credentials
Resolve repository access for intended developers

objectives.title: Promote reviewed winners with rollback
acceptance: Require independent approval for exact evaluated source
Materialize the chosen composition and its dependencies
Deploy gradually and collect production evidence
Restore the previous approved version after a controlled failure

objectives.title: Validate security, capacity and operational recovery
acceptance: Confirm original findings with the external scanner
Deliver alerts to an explicitly configured independent receiver
Measure real concurrent users and candidate executions
Verify recovery with controlled traffic switching
Preserve source, learning and audit without restoring revoked sessions

objectives.title: Integrate ACE into VS Code
acceptance: Connect to a selected private project
Browse native versions, source differences and evidence
Submit and observe proposals with permission checks
Expose learning and review actions without leaking credentials

first_task.title: Match local and hosted native history capacity
acceptance: Accept exactly 1024 valid native versions and reject a new one
Accept exactly 4096 valid branch events and reject a new one
Clone and restore the maximum-size valid history
Keep existing Rust, Worker and client checks passing
